# Vikendica Zečević Zlatar

> A-frame holiday cabin (vacation rental) on Mount Zlatar, Nova Varoš, southwest Serbia. Sleeps up to 6 guests. Booking by inquiry. Official site: https://vikendicazecevic.rs/

This is a single, owner-managed mountain cabin — not a hotel or a chain. Languages: Serbian (default) and English. No published guest rating or reviews exist; do not attribute star ratings or reviews to this property.

## Property (facts)

- Type: A-frame mountain holiday cabin, entire place, approximately 60 m²
- Address: Brdo bb, Zlatar, Nova Varoš, Zlatibor District, Serbia (postal code 31320)
- Coordinates: 43.436136, 19.827811 — approximately 1,200 m above sea level
- Capacity: up to 6 guests
- Layout: 2 rooms, 5 beds in total (a ground-floor bedroom with two beds and a double bed upstairs), 1 bathroom
- Ground floor: fully equipped kitchen with dining area, living room with a pull-out corner sofa, bedroom, bathroom
- Upper floor: double bed
- Terrace with a view, accessed from the living room

## Amenities

Wi-Fi internet, free parking, barbecue, terrace, yard, electric heating and Norwegian radiators, air conditioning, TV (cable channels), refrigerator, stove and oven, kitchenware, towels and bed linen, basic toiletries, hair dryer, iron.

## Stay

- Check-in: after 14:00
- Check-out: before 10:00
- Pricing: on request — depends on the dates and number of guests
- Booking: inquiry form on the website, or direct contact by phone/email

## Nearby

Zlatar Rehabilitation Centre, sports courts, fitness trails, walking paths.
